g.text: hey babes, u there? got something 4 u
hey cuz, u there? got something 4 u
so i've been thinking 4 a while, about... well, everything, really. 'bout u, me, the team, everything since u showed up
uh. ok m8, i'll just put that back in my pants then, shit
n how mad i was at everything n everybody 4 taking my future, my dreams away from me, yeah? especially arthur...
thinking i had no way forward, no hope for... anything that i wanted
n i never stopped 2 think that maybe, hey... knobhead? what u want can change. n maybe what u got *is what u've been dreamin' of this whole time*
i look around now n i see... i see community. n yeah, sure, fine, we still got techrot buzzin' us like flies, n there's still viktor out there bein' a proper plumsack
but none of that ain't shit we can't handle. because of u. because u made US something REAL
i get 2 take care of the kids around here, got eleanor telling 'em stories, aoi's given 'em toys - got speedster making lil gadgets for em now...
even His Maj looks happy 4 the first time in... maybe ever
n i realized if i hadn't stomped outta that tent with him that day, n followed him here, i never would've had all this
so i uh... just wanted 2 tell u that i... told arthur i was sorry. 4 treating him like shit. n that i was just angry 'n scared
n that i knew he was only ever trying 2 do the right thing 4 me n everybody else. n i respected that the whole time, even if i didn't know how 2 show it
arthur n i ain't never gonna be huggers, m8. u never gonna see us pull one in. but we shook hands. n he smiled at me
n i smiled back and said
he laughed! finally got that's my sense of humor, yeah?
patted me on the shoulder n off we went
n... that felt good. real good. don't got that hanging over me anymore
n that's all because of u
so, babes? i just... wanted 2 say... thnx. n that... well?
so, cuz? i just wanted 2 say... u got a m8 for life in me, now
we're not just besties, we're fam. thnx. for being here. for all that u do
I... oh. I'm sorry, I'm really not ready for this kind of commitment.
of all the times n places of all the ppl... u n me. never woulda dreamed it. but i wouldn't trade it 4 the world
just go ahead n slam my dick in the door
so... thnx, babes. for being u. n for all that u do
y'know what nvm. w/e. w/e. it's cool
but this is exactly the kinda shit i've been talking about this whole time. just sayin'
